title: Beams for the long roof
Logs before the snow
summary: {settlement} is raising a {place} the old way, log on log, and the woodpile is gone. Bring {count} × {item} to {giver}.
Snow is coming and the {place} in {settlement} has no roof. {count} × {item} will close it in.
offer: A {place} wants straight logs, and we've burned the last of ours for warmth. {count} × {item}, and you'll eat at our fire this winter.
The frost is in the ground already. Bring {count} × {item} and we'll have the {place} closed before the first blizzard.
progress: The roof is waiting on your logs.
Not yet? The wind is already sharp.
complete: Fine timber. The beams will stand a hundred winters.
Now we build. Come and drink with us when it's done.
